resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts each place a 1930s log cabin and platform tower. A 1973 draft history quoted by Forest Lookouts says the point never had a building, was always a tent camp, and was abandoned before 1940. The record keeps the 1930s entries and reports the draft.

Firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts date abandonment to the 1960s. The 1973 draft quoted by Forest Lookouts says the point was abandoned before 1940. The record keeps the 1960s and reports the draft.

The statewide list gives 45.50323, -114.81657, a different spot from the brief point (45.85881, -114.87705). The Forest Lookouts township 25N-13E-14 and firelookout.com's 18 miles SSW of Magruder R.S. are not converted to a point. Location is unresolved.

notes_for_editor: Build dates are decade-only (1930s) and the 1960s abandonment has no year. The 1973 draft by O.F. Schumaker, as quoted by Forest Lookouts, conflicts with the three 1930s cabin entries; both are reported. Two coordinate points differ by about 25 miles and neither is verified; the brief point should be checked against a map before it is used. No source describes what is on the point today. The firelookout.com page has a 'Click for larger image' link but no image URL was read, so no photos are added.
